messages:
Jules: Heads-up 8/11 launch9 0% case spotlight request from Nimbus Health. They want a short case study + 30min interview and a 15min webinar slot the following week. Need volunteer(s) for interview and a publishable quote.

Rina: I can host the webinar segment and moderate the interview. Available Thu/Fri afternoons PT.

Omar: I'll own the case write-up. Can we get a tight metric to lead with? Nimbus mentioned \"30% lower inference cost\" in the pitch deck but no baseline. Need confirmation.

Priya: I'll collect creative assets and the signed release. Ask them for a transparent baseline (e.g., cost per 1k tokens or per-API call) so legal can vet any comparative language. Also need logo (SVG) and one landscape hero photo.

Diego: For webinar ops please confirm preferred timezone for attendees and whether they want gated registration. If gated, sales-ops, please confirm routing.

sales-ops: Route note: If gated, tag leads with source:webinar-nimbus and route to AE team \"Enterprise-NE\". Also add lead priority=warm for attendees who opt for a demo.

Jules: Interview goals: 1) quick problem statement, 2) why Redwood, 3) measured impact, 4) one short quote we can publish, 5) ask about roadmap hooks. Keep it under 30m.

Rina: Draft interview Qs: - Can you describe the inference workload and the bottlenecks you hit? - What changes did Redwood enable in your deployment and release cadence? - Any quantitative wins you can share? - How does this affect product metrics (engagement/revenue)? - Would you recommend Redwood to other infra teams?

Omar: Draft lead quote for customer to edit: \"Redwood helped us cut inference cost and improve tail latency so we could push feature X to production faster.\"

legal-bot: Reminder: avoid unqualified superlatives. If using cost or latency numbers, customer must provide sources and sign quote. We require a signed media release for any on-camera recording.

Priya: Also flag: Nimbus is in health tech, so double-check PHI/PII language. We asked them to confirm the case study contains no patient-identifiable information and to provide an A/B statement we can publish (non-sensitive).

Diego: Webinar logistics: proposed date Wed 10/12 10am PT, 30 minutes with 15m demo + 10m live Q&A. Rina 6 Jules confirm?

Rina: Confirmed for me. Jules can you lock Nimbus?

Jules: Sent scheduler link to Nimbus PM for Tue/Thu interview windows and asked for confirmation on the 30% cost claim with baseline (previous provider + time period). Also requested SVG logo, landscape headshot, and an executive quote in GDoc for redlines.

Omar: Once we have numbers I'll draft the benchmark narrative: baseline, workload, optimization (batching/quantization/route policy), and final delta. Keep the narrative neutral and include a methodology note.

Priya: Assets ETA 48h if they approve. Will upload to #secure-assets and share the link with the team when done.

sales-ops: If gated, need form fields: name, company, email, role, use-case. Also include consent checkbox for follow-up.

Jules: Good. Post-interview deliverables: Omar to circulate first draft within 24h, Rina to produce 60-90s highlight clip, Priya to get the signed release and assets, legal-bot to confirm legal clearance, approvals-bot to queue for publish.

Nimbus-ops: Reply from customer: confirmed interview Tue 9/13 11am PT. They confirm 30% is versus their previous on-prem pipeline (Apr-Jun baseline). Will send SVG + landscape headshot by EOD. Will provide a GDoc quote after the call for redline.

Omar: Great  I'll prep the benchmark appendix and note the Apr-Jun baseline.

legal-bot: Action: need quote GDoc link and signed release. Once GDoc is returned with exact phrasing, legal will review within one business day.

Jules: Timeline check: interview Tue 9/13, draft out Wed 9/14, customer sign-off Thu 9/15 morning, publish prep Thu afternoon -> publish Friday if all clear.

Rina: I'll draft social copy variants focusing either on (a) cost savings headline or (b) stability-under-load headline. Team vote after draft.

Omar: Quick note on messaging: avoid specific numbers in Twitter cards unless customer explicitly approves. Use metric in blog + benchmark appendix.

Priya: Assets received from Nimbus (SVG + headshot) and GDoc shared post-interview. Uploading to secure-assets now.

approvals-bot: Approval requested: marketing/customer-spotlight-nimbus  status: waiting_on -> customer_signoff, legal_review.

Jules: Thanks everyone. Small ask for Sales: if gated webinar, can a rep be available for 30m after the webinar for qualified demos? sales-ops?

sales-ops: Yes, will tentatively book an AE on standby. Final routing will use source:webinar-nimbus tag.

Rina: Post-interview note: Nimbus approved the edited quote verbatim in the GDoc. Sending to legal for final sign-off.

legal-bot: Legal sign-off complete. Release signed. approvals-bot: moving to queue.

approvals-bot: Status update: waiting_on -> approvals_queue."
